ValidationRule.description: User must choose either case record, case participation or client -- only 1 of the 3 is allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(IF(Case_Record__c != null, 1, 0) + IF(Case_Participation__c != null, 1, 0) + IF(Client__c != null, 1, 0) > 1, true, false)
